attributes.name: circuit
attributes.description: Select the filter circuit used for the Low-pass, High-pass, Band-pass, Notch, and Morph filters.

choices.label: The DFM filter internally feeds back more of its distortion for a broad range of tones from subtle filter sweeps to warm drive.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: djcontrol
attributes.description: Controls the transition between low-pass and high-pass filtering. Values above 0.0 filter out low frequencies, while values below 0.0 filter out high frequencies. The filter resonance also shifts as the filtering changes: values near 0.0% result in only a slight boost of the emphasized frequencies; this boost grows progressively as values near -1.0 or 1.0.

attributes.name: drive
attributes.description: Applies additional input drive to the signal before it reaches the filter to add distortion. At 0.0, the signal remains clean and unaltered. As thevalue is increased, most filter types will progressively blend in the distortion for a more saturated sound.

attributes.name: envamount
attributes.description: Determines the extent to which the envelope modulation affects the filter frequency.

attributes.name: envattack
attributes.description: Sets how quickly the envelope responds to rising input levels.

attributes.name: envhold
attributes.description: When on, the envelope completes the entire attack phase before the release phase is started.

attributes.name: envrelease
attributes.description: Sets how quickly the envelope responds to falling input levels.

attributes.name: filterslope
attributes.description: Sets the filter slope for low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, and notch + LP filters.

attributes.name: filtertype
attributes.description: Sets the filter type

attributes.description: Sets the filter cutoff frequency

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ins
attributes.description: Declares additional inlets that can be used to control float-type attributes at either event or signal rate. Any declared attributes already mapped to inlets will be ignored. This attribute can only be set when the object is instantiated.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: lfoamount
attributes.description: Sets the amount of LFO modulation.

attributes.name: lfomorph
attributes.description: Morphs the LFO waveform.

attributes.name: lfophase
attributes.description: Adjusts the offset between the left and right LFO channels. At 180 degrees, the LFO channels will be perfectly out of phase.

attributes.name: lfophaseoffset
attributes.description: Shifts the starting point of both LFO channels along their waveforms.

attributes.name: lfoquantize
attributes.description: Sets the quantization mode for the LFO.

choices.label: Divides the LFO cycle into a number of discrete intervals.

attributes.name: lfosmoothing
attributes.description: Applies smoothing to the LFO Sample and Hold waveform.

attributes.name: lfospin
attributes.description: Detunes the left and right LFOs relative to each other.

attributes.name: lfosteps
attributes.description: Defines how many discrete steps are used to divide the LFO cycle.

attributes.name: lfostereo
attributes.description: Sets the LFO stereo offset mode.

choices.label: Offsets the left and right modulation channels using degrees.
Progressively diverges the left and right channels of the LFO.

attributes.name: lfowaveform
attributes.description: Sets the waveform used by the LFO.

attributes.name: mix
attributes.description: Sets the dry/wet mix of the output signal.

attributes.name: morph
attributes.description: Sets the filter position in its morph cycle.For the Morph filter, you can smoothly transition between low-pass, band-pass, and high-pass filtering.For the Comb filter, you can shift the filter between either the peaks or notches that appear at multiples of the set filter.For the Notch+LP filter, you can shift the position of the notch relative to the low-pass cutoff. For the Vowel filter, you can increasingly normalize the gain of the formants.

attributes.name: morphslope
attributes.description: Sets the filter slope for the Morph filter.

attributes.name: output
attributes.description: Defines the wet signal level at the output of the device in dB.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: Activates oversampling hi-quality mode, which helps reduce unwanted artifacts.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: resonance
attributes.description: Defines the amount of emphasis at the cutoff frequency specified by.

attributes.name: sceq
attributes.description: When enabled, the internal envelope will only react to the range of frequencies specified by the set filter type and Sidechain EQ controls. By default, a high-pass filter is selected, so the envelope primarily responds to transients, while slower components such as synth envelopes or kick drum tails are ignored.

attributes.name: sceqtype
attributes.description: Select the filter type used for the sidechain EQ.

attributes.name: scfrequency
attributes.description: Sets the frequency of sidechain input EQ filtering.

attributes.name: scgain
attributes.description: Adjusts the level of the external sidechain signal.

attributes.name: sclisten
attributes.description: Enable this switch to bypass the device's output so that only the sidechain input is audible. This is useful for fine-tuning the sidechain settings.

attributes.name: scmono
attributes.description: Converts the sidechain signal to mono so that the envelope follower modulation is identical across the left and right channels. When enabled, only the third inlet of the object is used as a sidechain signal. When disabled, both the third and fourth inlets will be used.

attributes.name: scresonance
attributes.description: Sets the resonance of the sidechain EQ filter.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: softclip
attributes.description: Enable to apply soft clipping to the device output. This is useful for limiting any peaks caused by high resonance values.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: vowelformant
attributes.description: Morphs through the following vowels: a, e, i, o, and u.

attributes.name: vowelpitch
attributes.description: Shifts the formants up or down by the set number of semitones.

inlets.description: Whenis enabled, receives the sidechain input signal. This is treated as the mono channel whenis on and as the left channel whenis off.
Whenis enabled andis disabled, receives the right channel of the sidechain input signal.
